baselinePolicy.behavior: Current Android source in this repository
baselinePolicy.appearance: Installed Android TV reference build captured in this directory
baselinePolicy.conflictRule: When the installed build and repository differ, preserve repository behavior and use the captures only for visual and interaction treatment. Record the conflict instead of silently copying it.

knownDifferences: The installed reference build exposes both Stalker / Ministra and Xtream Codes providers; the current repository source does not contain the Xtream provider model.
No IPTV portal was configured in the emulator. Live channel playback, the player HUD, Game View, and Multi-View could not be reached from real streams.
The configured sports-data fixture changes with time, so scores and event identities are reference content rather than pixel-stable acceptance data.
focusBehavior: Focused controls use a bright cyan outline; primary focused actions also use a white fill with dark text.
The selected top-level route uses a restrained dark outlined pill and is visually distinct from the brighter focus ring.
From the focused Home navigation item, D-pad Down moved directly to the first Live Now card in the observed state.
Settings uses an explicit vertical focus graph: D-pad Down moves one section and Select opens it while retaining the cyan section outline.
The entire 16:9 composition remains fixed; shelves page or clip horizontally rather than reflowing into a browser layout.

screens.state: Final event with matchup stats, top performers, and analytics
Following and Games for You sections
Overview tab with recent form and next game
Search field focused with Android TV keyboard
